d:
Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge addressed a public rally in Sangrur, Punjab, to kick off the party's election campaign alongside Rahul Gandhi, Sachin Pilot, and senior state leaders. In his speech, Kharge asserted, 'Agar hum Punjab jeetenge toh sara Bharat jeetenge,' urging party workers to maintain unity to defeat their opponents. He sharply attacked the ruling Aam Aadmi Party government in Punjab, alleging pervasive corruption, deteriorating law and order, and a failure to curb the drug menace.
Thank you for watching our video!
